entries.summary: Removed the repo-wide change-freeze enforced by the unified-skillpack conformance check (tools/validate_unified_skillpacks.py, from the now-inert .claude/skillpacks/ migration). It fail-closed on any file changed outside a fixed allowed_change_paths list since a pinned base commit, which blocked ordinary, unrelated PRs. Replaced with a passive, non-enforcing record of files changed since the pinned base. This governance/change_log.json file is introduced at the same time as the self-tracker every federation repo now carries.

Turned on the change-coupled documentation gate defined by thehub-pr ADR 0010. Its tooling (the shared tools/check_docs_sync.py, the docs-sync workflow, the Claude Code Stop hook and CLAUDE.md) came in with #648 in report mode with no couplings; this entry gives the repo its own .federation/docs-sync.json (four couplings, enforce mode) and re-pins PRII_TEMPLATE_REF from thehub-pr 796951e to 09e2e54, which carries the checker's fix for path:symbol references. The pre-commit hook, PR-template line and CONTRIBUTING sections this repo does not render from the hub were added by hand, and .gitignore now tracks .claude/settings.json. Tooling and workflow change only: no contract, schema or dependency edge changed. PROVISIONAL until docs-sync is a required status check on main.

Re-pinned PRII_TEMPLATE_REF to thehub-pr 4258c3c, which hardens the shared docs-sync checker (thehub-pr#359): a pull request can no longer exempt itself through exempt_authors, manifest hygiene is judged on the head manifest so retiring a coupling or renaming a coupled doc no longer fails, a glob that matches nothing now fails when the change adds it, and a :symbol or :line locator is dropped from Markdown link targets. The manifest comment now says a coupling fires on its on events, and the hand-kept CONTRIBUTING.md section now says what the gate enforces: the on events, that the reference check reads root Markdown and docs/**, and that a glob a change adds that matches nothing fails. The shared eslint config also picked up one optional glob (src/zip-design, thehub-pr#358); that directory holds no JavaScript here, so lint coverage is unchanged. Tooling and documentation change only: no contract, schema or dependency edge changed.

Re-pinned PRII_TEMPLATE_REF from thehub-pr 4258c3c to d916664 and re-rendered the federation templates. The vendored schemas/federation_export_manifest.schema.json gains the optional source_monitors stream (thehub-pr ADR 0013) so a follow-up change can emit it; nothing emits it yet, and governance/federation_compatibility.json records the review as COMPATIBLE. The Grid V2 Cell_Profile files move from pr-grid-v2-cell-profile/1.0 to 1.2 (hub template commit a68ffed): evidence-gated ADMINISTRATIVE_SET and DERIVED_SET rows now enter profiles as non-exact counts, binding receipts must name a migration provenance class, and the materializer gains an incremental refresh mode. tests/test_pr_grid_v2_profile_template_authority.py now locks a68ffed and the 1.2 blobs, including the materializer as the other producers do. The shared docs-sync checker also honors the base manifest's exempt_authors on --staged runs (thehub-pr#389). The three rendered Cell_Profile files are not ruff-format clean under this repo's 100-column config and their bytes belong to the hub template, so the lint.yml format gate and the ruff-format pre-commit hook now exclude them alongside the certified leaderboard runtime files; ruff check still lints them. make format and make format-check read the same exclusion from lint.yml, and CONTRIBUTING.md, SETUP.md, the PR template and the pyproject.toml comment now describe that gate instead of a bare ruff format --check. TERMINAL_READY.txt now describes Cell_Profile 1.2 admission and authority. The grid authority stays at spiderweb-pr 0c66e13: federation/spatial/pr_grid_geographic_v2.pin.json and the runtime are unchanged.

moneysweep-pr now emits the thehub-pr ADR 0013 source_monitors stream from scripts/federation_export.py: 167 rows projected from reports/source_registry_status.csv exactly as the hub's ADR 0012 registry reader derived them, all NOT_RECORDED because there is no data/source_run_state.json. Pins prii-export-utils 0.2.0 at thehub-pr 0f62e4b in requirements.in, requirements.txt and requirements.lock. Re-exports the committed data/exports/canonical_v1_federation package with only the new stream added (sources, entities and relationships byte-unchanged; the pre-existing entities confidence drift is not carried). Adds the internal GUI capability fragment and tests, names the new pinned package in README.md, SETUP.md and docs/DESKTOP_OFFLINE_BOOTSTRAP.md, and records the compatibility review as COMPATIBLE. Once this lands, the hub can move moneysweep-pr from REGISTRIES to STREAM_PRODUCERS and retire its registry reader.

Adopted the hub's canonical GUI capability parity checker. Re-pinned PRII_TEMPLATE_REF from thehub-pr d916664 to 76d3c08 and rendered the four GUI rule files from the hub's templates: scripts/check_gui_parity.py, tests/test_gui_parity.py, docs/GUI_CAPABILITY_PARITY.md and the gui-capability-parity workflow. The checker merges .federation/gui-capabilities.extensions itself, so the local wrapper .federation/check_gui_parity_with_extensions.py and the tracked artifacts/gui-capabilities-merged.json were removed. Twelve extension fragments gained an extension_id equal to their file name; no capability, exception or classification in any fragment changed. The base manifest gained discovery.e2e_config, stopped citing the mocked zip-design spec as end-to-end proof for six capabilities, and cites ownership-deep-dive.spec.mjs for ownership-deep-dive. Three real-backend specs that no workflow ran were added to the parity Playwright config. The parity baseline was not regenerated: the checker reports the same legacy count and no new findings. AGENTS.md, the pull request template, the README banners and the docs-sync manifest were updated to match. No federation contract surface, schema or export changed. The pin is the last commit of thehub-pr#432, which is on thehub-pr main; it deliberately stops before the hub commit that moves the shared prii-desktop runtime pin to the Launch Pad release, because that desktop upgrade needs its own change and its own frozen-build verification.
